thread:
jamal: Heads up — PR #9337 is blocking the 16:00 cutover. Needs 2x LGTM before cutoff. CI is green except one flaky e2e; I've pinned the deploy flag. @tina @alex can one of you give a second? Release window in ~50m.
tina: On it, will review now. If it's small, I can approve.
alex: Taking a look. quick note: the kv cache tweak touches runtime hot path, running smoke locally.
jamal: TY. quick repro I ran: ```
make smoke && ./scripts/run-smoke --shards=2
``` logs: /tmp/smoke.log
alex: Smoke looks clean locally, found one lint nit and pushed a tiny fix to the branch. @priya are you free for cutover?
priya: I'm on-call and can second if tests look good. CI shows a flaky test `kv-warmup/prefetch` — rerun queued.
release-bot: CI rerun started for PR #9337 (build 4523).
tina: approved :thumbsup: 
jamal: awesome — that's 2x LGTM. Let's hold merge until the post-green smoke completes and then merge. I'll coordinate the cutover.
alex: I can run the final smoke in 10m. Tag me when CI is green.
release-bot: CI build 4523 passed. All checks green.
jamal: merging in ~2m. Merge command: ```
./tools/merge --pr=9337 --safeguard=canary
``` I'll monitor logs and KV hit-rates.
priya: :rocket: good luck.
tina: thanks team — I'll watch the console dashboards for latency and error rate. If anything looks off, we can autoswitch to fallback model.
jamal: Post-merge rollback plan: revert PR 9337 (revert PR 9342) and redeploy. I'll post in #incidents if we need to back out.
jamal: (follow-up) merged and canary rollout 10% -> 50% progressing, no regressions so far.
